function.name: calculate_velocity
function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time for which the object is in motion in seconds. This is a float type value.

message.content:

|----------|----------|------|----------|
| 2026‑05‑15 | **《星際之門：黎明》** | 科幻/冒險 | 亞歷克斯·羅伯遜、艾米莉·華盛頓 |
| 2026‑05‑20 | **《失落的城市》** | 動作/驚悚 | 盧卡斯·費雪、凱瑟琳·李 |

| 2026‑06‑01 | **《黑暗之城》** | 懸疑/犯罪 | 彼得·馬丁、艾莉森·史密斯 |
| 2026‑06‑05 | **《未來之光》** | 動畫/家庭 | 內部配音團隊 |
| 2026‑06‑10 | **《最後的戰士》** | 歷史/戰爭 | 里奧·貝爾、凱特·布朗 |
| 2026‑06‑15 | **《心靈之旅》** | 心理/驚悚 | 朱莉亞·羅德、馬修·艾倫 |

> - 上表僅列出部分主流市場（美國、歐洲、亞洲）的新片。  
> - 若您對某個特定類型或地區的電影感興趣，請告訴我，我可以為您提供更精準的推薦。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "最新的電影上映有哪些？" meaning "What are the latest movie releases?" They want a list of recent movies. We need to provide a list. There's no function call needed. Just answer. Probably mention some recent releases. We can give a few examples. Provide a short list.
